name: God Caring For Widows
overview: Scripture reveals God's special care and protection for widows, emphasizing that they are not to be oppressed or neglected. God is described as a defender and judge for widows, ensuring their needs are met and their rights upheld, as seen in commands against afflicting widows (Exodus 22:22) and warnings against perverting their judgment (Deuteronomy 27:19). The Psalms further affirm God's tender compassion, highlighting His preservation and relief of widows and the healing of those brokenhearted (Psalms 68:5; 146:9; 147:3). This care is woven into the covenantal life of Israel, reflecting God's holiness and justice toward vulnerable members of the community.
